source_caption:
This Is Not Okay follows a teenager struggling to understand her emotions while dealing with the complicated realities of school, family, friendship, and growing up. What begins as an ordinary teenage life gradually becomes more difficult as personal problems start piling up.
As she tries to figure out where she belongs, she faces awkward situations, complicated relationships, and emotions that are often difficult to explain. The pressure of fitting in only makes everything more overwhelming.
The story explores themes of loneliness, identity, friendship, family, insecurity, and the challenges of adolescence. Beneath the humor and everyday moments is a character trying to understand herself while dealing with situations that feel completely out of her control.
What makes the story relatable is its focus on the uncomfortable side of growing up. Not every problem has an easy solution, and sometimes simply getting through the day can feel like an achievement.
More than just a coming-of-age story, This Is Not Okay captures the confusion of being young, trying to understand yourself, and realizing that life rarely goes exactly as planned.
💬 Have you ever felt like everything was becoming too much at once?
